item.schematic_cannon.empty_schematic.to: Used as a recipe ingredient and for writing at the _Schematic Table_.

schematic_cannon.config.option.creativeP: Whether placing a Schematic directly in Creative Mode should replace world blocks with Air
schematic_cannon.config.option.enableToo: Show the summary and usage hints in item tooltips when holding the Sneak key.
schematic_cannon.config.option.smoothAni: Animate moving, rotating and flipping schematics and selections. When off, rotating and flipping happen instantly and positions jump block by block.
schematic_cannon.config.option.maxSchema: The maximum packet size uploaded Schematics are split into. Between 256 and 31000.
The amount of Schematics a player can upload until previous ones are overwritten.
schematic_cannon.config.option.maxTotalS: The maximum allowed file size of uploaded Schematics.
schematic_cannon.config.option.schematic: Amount of game ticks between shots of the cannon. Higher => Slower
Amount of blocks a Schematicannon can print per Gunpowder item provided.
Amount of game ticks without new packets arriving until an active schematic upload process is discarded.

schematic_cannon.config.title: Schematic Cannon Settings
schematic_cannon.gui.schematicannon.opti: The cannon will never replace any Solid blocks in its working area, only non-Solid and Air.
The cannon will replace Solid blocks in its working area if the Schematic contains any Block at the Location.
The cannon will clear out all blocks in its working area, including those replaced by Air.
The cannon will only replace Solid blocks in its working area if the Schematic contains a solid Block at the Location.
The cannon will avoid replacing data holding blocks such as Chests.
If the cannon cannot find a required Block for placement, it will continue at the next Location.
